t: This is Finsbury Park station, a busy interchange in North London where the Underground, National Rail and London buses all meet. It sits in fare zone 2, and it's the third busiest Underground station outside zone 1, with over 33 million passengers in 2019. It is also where the musician Graham Bond died, in 1974. Bond was an English rock and blues musician and vocalist, considered a founding father of the English rhythm and blues boom of the 1960s.
